profile.edit.title: Edit profile
profile.edit.description: Your picture and bio are visible to other officers; your look applies to your own tablet only.
profile.edit.saved_pending: Saved. Your new picture or bio shows once a supervisor approves it.
profile.edit.cooldown: You can change your picture or bio again in {time}.
profile.edit.url_hint: An https link to a .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp image on an allowed host. {n} link(s) left today.
profile.edit.pending_picture: Your new picture is waiting for a supervisor. Everyone else still sees your old one.
profile.edit.rejected_picture: Your last picture link was not approved.
profile.edit.bio_hint: Plain text, up to {max} characters and {lines} lines.
profile.edit.pending_bio: Your new bio is waiting for a supervisor. Everyone else still sees your old one.
profile.edit.appearance_hint: Worked out from your department's colours; the logo and header never change.
profile.edit.accent_hint: From your department's palette; some colours unlock at a level.
profile.edit.mute_hint: No toast or tone for new mission calls. Dispatch still lists them.
profile.edit.look_own: Your look only changes your own tablet.
profile.look.title: Look
profile.service.title: Service record
profile.service.clean_hint: Arrests ÷ (arrests + suspects killed). Only you see this.
profile.commend.title: Commendations
profile.commend.revoke_text: It leaves the officer's profile. The revoke is written to the audit log.
profile.commend.dialog_text: Commendations carry no points and no cash. Every commendation is written to the audit log.
profile.commend.run_hint: Optional. Never a run you took part in.
profile.report.title: Report {name}'s profile
profile.report.text: Staff of their department review it. They are not told who reported them.
profile.review.empty_text: New pictures, bios waiting for approval and profile reports show here.
profile.review.confirm_text: Officer: {name}. Your decision and reason are written to the audit log.
profile.review.avatar_reject: Your new picture was not approved; your old one stays.
profile.review.bio_reject: Your new bio was not approved; your old one stays.
err.profile_cooldown: You changed your profile a moment ago. Try again in a few minutes.
err.avatar_locked: That picture unlocks at a higher level.
err.avatar_urls_off: Image links are switched off on this server.
err.avatar_url_invalid: That link can't be used: no spaces, quotes or angle brackets.
err.avatar_url_too_long: The link can be at most 255 characters.
err.avatar_url_https: The link must start with https://.
err.avatar_url_host: Images from that site are not allowed here.
err.avatar_url_ext: The link must point to a .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp image.
err.avatar_url_limit: You have used today's picture links.
err.bio_lines: Your bio has too many lines.
err.bio_banned: Your bio contains a word that is not allowed.
err.accent_invalid: That colour is not in your department's palette.
err.accent_locked: That colour unlocks at a higher level.
err.report_self: You can't report your own profile.
err.report_too_long: The details can be at most 140 characters.
err.report_duplicate: You already reported this profile today.
err.report_limit: You have sent today's profile reports.
err.citation_long: The citation can be at most 255 characters.
err.commend_other_dept: You can only commend officers of your own department.
err.commend_recent: That officer got this kind of commendation in the last 7 days.
err.commend_own_run: You took part in that run, so you can't commend for it.
err.commend_run: That officer did not take part in that run.
err.not_issuer: Only the officer who gave it, or an admin, can revoke it.
err.own_profile: You can't moderate your own profile.
err.profile_other_dept: That officer belongs to another department.
